label: Time stretch
intent: The clip is stretched and its keyframes spread in proportion. Light: the clip's end is pulled out to its new length and stops dead a little past it; the nearer key follows, then the farther one, each landing in turn and settling. Strong: the clip first squeezes in (the keys bunch up), then is pulled out hard past its new length and settles in decaying beats, with the keys arriving in order behind it. The ruler never moves; the preview reset fades it back.

bar.//: stretch 0 = v1's 13-long clip, 1 = its 21-long result; the driver passes 1 for the overshoot

key-1.x.//: the clip end's beats x 5.6 (v1's spread of the nearer key), landing 50 ms after it

key-0.x.//: 2.4 / 5.6 of the nearer key (v1's spread of the farther key), 50 ms behind it
